kurals.tr: Avarnenju Avarkkaadhal Kantum Evannenje / Neeemakku Aakaa Thadhu
kurals.m: O my soul! although you have seen how his soul stands by him, how is it you do not stand by me?

kurals.tr: Uraaa Thavarkkanta Kannum Avaraich / Cheraaarenach Cheriyen Nenju
kurals.m: O my soul! although you have known him who does not love me, still do you go to him, saying "he will not be displeased."

kurals.tr: Kettaarkku Nattaaril Enpadho Nenjenee / Pettaangu Avarpin Selal
kurals.m: O my soul! do you follow him at pleasure under the belief that the ruined have no friends?

kurals.tr: Inianna Ninnotu Soozhvaaryaar Nenje / Thuniseydhu Thuvvaaikaan Matru
kurals.m: O my soul! you would not first seem sulky and then enjoy (him); who then would in future consult you about such things?

kurals.tr: Peraaamai Anjum Perinpirivu Anjum / Araaa Itumpaiththen Nenju
kurals.m: My soul fears when it is without him; it also fears when it is with him; it is subject to incessant sorrow

kurals.tr: Thaniye Irundhu Ninaiththakkaal Ennaith / Thiniya Irundhadhen Nenju
kurals.m: My mind has been (here) in order to eat me up (as it were) whenever I think of him in my solitude

kurals.tr: Naanum Marandhen Avarmarak Kallaaen / Maanaa Matanenjir Pattu
kurals.m: I have even forgotten my modesty, having been caught in my foolish mind which is not dignified enough to forget him

kurals.tr: Ellin Ilivaamendru Enni Avardhiram / Ullum Uyirkkaadhal Nenju
kurals.m: My soul which clings to life thinks only of his (own) gain in the belief that it would be disgraceful for it to despise him

kurals.tr: Thunpaththirku Yaare Thunaiyaavaar Thaamutaiya / Nenjan Thunaiyal Vazhi
kurals.m: Who would help me out of one's distress, when one's own soul refuses help to one?

kurals.tr: Thanjam Thamarallar Edhilaar Thaamutaiya / Nenjam Thamaral Vazhi
kurals.m: It is hardly possible for strangers to behave like relations, when one's own soul acts like a stranger
